title: Will Generac's Free Cash Flow Outpace Its Rising Capital Needs?
author: Na
description: Generac Holdings maintains its $350 million 2026 free cash flow forecast while increasing capital spending to 4.5% of sales to expand production capacity for its booming data center business. The company has secured $1.6 billion in data center backlog and two multi-year supply agreements, with capital investments expected to pay back in under 12 months. Competitors Caterpillar and Cummins are also benefiting from strong data center power demand.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Company maintains strong free cash flow guidance of $350M despite increased capex, has secured $1.6B data center backlog with multi-year agreements, expects capex payback in under 12 months, and Q2 cash flow improved significantly YoY. Stock up 22.4% in past month and trading at lower valuation than sector peers.

Benefiting from broad demand across multiple markets including data center power, supported by record backlog, growing services, and strong cash generation. Management expects strong Q3 2026 growth and mid-to-high teens sales growth for full year.

Benefiting from sustained data center power demand and multi-year backup power commitments. Company raised 2026 revenue growth forecast to 10-13% from 8-11% and raised EBITDA margin outlook to 18-18.5%, reflecting stronger demand across key markets.

title: Caterpillar Inc. (CAT) is Attracting Investor Attention: Here is What You Should Know
author: Zacks.Com
description: Caterpillar has attracted investor attention with strong earnings growth expectations of +40.4% for the current quarter and +44.2% for the fiscal year. The company has consistently beaten consensus estimates and shows solid revenue growth projections. However, it carries a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating and trades at a premium valuation (Grade D) compared to peers, suggesting it may perform in line with the broader market in the near term.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: While Caterpillar demonstrates strong fundamental metrics including 40.4% YoY earnings growth, consistent beat history, and solid revenue growth projections, the Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating and premium valuation (Grade D) suggest limited near-term upside. The stock is expected to perform in line with the broader market rather than outperform, warranting a neutral stance despite positive earnings momentum.

title: 3 Dividend Paying Stocks Offering AI Exposure
author: Na
description: Three technology and industrial stocks with AI tailwinds offer dividend payouts to income-focused investors. Broadcom has entered the AI race with strong cash generation and a 12.7% five-year dividend growth rate. Vertiv provides data center infrastructure solutions with modest yield. Caterpillar powers data centers with reciprocating engines and holds Dividend Aristocrat status.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Company has posted record revenue, entered the AI race with strong portfolio evolution, demonstrates strong cash-generating abilities, and maintains a shareholder-friendly 12.7% five-year annualized dividend growth rate.
Provides essential data center infrastructure solutions with strong growth potential from data center buildout driven by AI demand, though current yield is modest at 0.1%.
Benefits from increased demand for power products in data center applications, deployed $7.9 billion in shareholder returns, holds elite Dividend Aristocrat status, and yields 0.8% annually.
